task.pr_title: imxrt: Add UART and DMA drivers

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: Is this possible to be safe in the first place, given that you are passing arbitrary pointers to the hardware.

evidence.thread_resolution:
felipebalbi: what would you suggest? Take a slice and unsafely convert to pointer internally or make the entire function unsafe and document safety guidelines?
i509VCB: Make the function here unsafe. Nothing prevents a caller from pointing the destination to the stack and corrupting the stack. The callers of this function which take slices are safe using this however since the slices cannot be aliased. (of course reading a bit further into this).
felipebalbi: Okay, updated both DMA and UART drivers. Managed to make the DMA driver a lot smaller by mimicking what embassy-rp as done. I think it reads a little better and it should be easier to maintain. Also addresses all your concerns regarding unsafe functions :)
